explication: Turbo Rails integrates browser-side Turbo navigation and stream subscriptions with Rails helpers, request handling, model broadcasts, and native-app navigation endpoints. The principal workflow is a browser interaction that Turbo sends to Rails, where Rails can render a full response, a frame response, or a stream update; broadcasts can also reach subscribed clients asynchronously. The README documents the broader product capabilities. Source evidence is sampled, so links without direct code evidence are grounded in that documentation rather than assumptions about unsampled implementation.
